notes: I set billing to 'unknown' because prices are charged per 28 days ('/28-day'), not per month. However, line 60 says 'Plans start as low as $50/month'. That conflicts with the 28-day pricing. Overage: line 132 says extra minutes are billed at the plan's 'Additional Minute rate', but it doesn't give the rate ('Ask your rep for the exact rate on your plan'). Line 136 says plans are month-to-month with a 28-day cancellation policy and no lock-in contract. Line 87 says every plan and price can be customised and negotiated. Line 120 says you can change plans with no penalty. Lines 102/110 claim 'Zero hidden platform fees'. The page does not mention a free trial.
